profile.headline: Senior Product Engineer | Full-Stack Software Engineer | React, Python, TypeScript, Django & GraphQL | Product Ownership & AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with 19 years of experience building, maintaining, and improving production applications across fintech, SaaS, logistics, and education.

Throughout my career, I've worked across the full stack, from developing user interfaces and backend services to designing APIs, integrating systems, and improving application reliability. My primary technologies include React, TypeScript, Python, Django, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.

More recently, my responsibilities have evolved beyond implementing features into owning business-critical applications and making decisions about their technical direction. At HaulPay, I'm responsible for the development and maintenance of our internal administration application and backend data-validation workflows. My work involves balancing product requirements, operational efficiency, security, and long-term maintainability while remaining actively involved in engineering.

Some of the work I'm particularly proud of includes:
• Improving financial transaction reliability by resolving ledger inconsistencies, preventing duplicate payouts, and strengthening contract and settlement workflows.
• Building API integrations and automation tools that synchronize thousands of records across systems.
• Developing internal dashboards that save Customer Service more than 10 hours of manual work each week.
• Resolving production security vulnerabilities and improving application reliability.
• Incorporating AI-assisted development into engineering workflows, using Claude Code and agentic tools to improve productivity while maintaining human oversight and code review.

I'm particularly interested in how AI is changing software engineering. I've been developing workflows that connect development tools, preserve technical context, and streamline implementation without sacrificing code quality or engineering judgment.

What I enjoy most is understanding how a product works, identifying where it can be improved, and building solutions that deliver meaningful value to the people who use it.

I bring a combination of hands-on engineering experience, product ownership, and business perspective to my work. I'm always interested in opportunities where I can solve challenging technical problems, improve existing systems, and help build products that make a difference.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I own the development and maintenance of HaulPay's internal administration application and backend data-validation workflows, combining hands-on engineering with product ownership to improve operational efficiency, financial accuracy, security, and reliability.

Key Contributions:
• Product Ownership: Drive the technical direction, development, and maintenance of internal applications and backend workflows, balancing business priorities with engineering decisions.
• Financial Systems: Improved contract conversion, ledger reconciliation, and settlement workflows using React, Python, Django, and GraphQL. Prevented duplicate payouts and resolved financial data inconsistencies.
• Application Security: Resolved production vulnerabilities involving authentication, authorization, and GraphQL data exposure, including an account-takeover vulnerability.
• Integrations & Automation: Built Python/Redis integrations with Cargo Chief and TAI, synchronizing thousands of records. Developed Streamlit dashboards saving Customer Service 10+ hours weekly.
• AI-Assisted Engineering: Adopted Claude Code, observing approximately 2× higher monthly Jira ticket activity. Designed agentic workflows integrating Jira, GitHub, Slack, and CI/CD with human code review.
• Context Engineering: Maintained 100+ persistent AI agent memory entries documenting fintech business rules, production incidents, and engineering conventions to preserve development context.

positions.title: Product Operations Engineer
positions.description:
Developed integrations, automation tools, and data-processing workflows supporting product operations and internal business systems at Vendr, a SaaS procurement platform.

Key Contributions:
• Product Integrations: Built TypeScript API integrations connecting ProductBoard, Shortcut, and Slack to streamline product operations, synchronize information, and reduce manual coordination.
• Data Processing: Developed TypeScript and SQL bulk-processing tools to improve contract ingestion and operational data management.
• System Reliability: Enhanced PostgreSQL contract ingestion through batch uploads and resumable processing, improving the reliability of large-scale data operations.
• Workflow Automation: Automated data cleanup and synchronization across thousands of records using Python and external APIs, improving data consistency and operatio

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack features for Kiddom's educational technology platform, supporting classroom collaboration, student onboarding, and digital learning experiences.

Key Contributions:
• Full-Stack Development: Built and maintained application features using React, TypeScript, Go, and Python, contributing across frontend and backend systems.
• Product Development: Implemented onboarding functionality spanning REST APIs, PostgreSQL database schemas, and reusable React components.
• Real-Time Collaboration: Developed interactive classroom features using WebSockets to support real-time communication and collaboration.
• Cross-Functional Delivery: Translated product requirements into maintainable application features, contributing to technical implementation and ongoing platform improvements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained internal business applications and integrations supporting financial operations, student attendance monitoring, and administrative workflows across Aspire Public Schools.

Key Contributions:
• Application Modernization: Designed and developed a financial application using Django, Angular, and PostgreSQL, replacing a legacy SharePoint-based solution with a maintainable web application.
• Workflow Automation: Built attendance monitoring and automated notification systems processing thousands of student records daily.
• Data Integration: Developed reporting pipelines and third-party integrations to improve operational visibility and reduce manual administrative work.
• Product Development: Worked with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into reliable applications and automated workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained large-scale web applications, messaging infrastructure, and backend services supporting SurveyMonkey's online survey platform and millions of users.

Key Contributions:
• Scalable Systems: Built high-volume messaging and notification systems supporting communication workflows at scale.
• Application Modernization: Developed Python microservices and contributed to migrating functionality from a monolithic .NET application toward a service-oriented architecture.
• Full-Stack Development: Delivered application features using C#, Backbone.js, JavaScript, SQL Server, and stored procedures.
• Performance Optimization: Improved backend communication and data serialization using MsgPack to support more efficient messaging between application components.
• Production Reliability: Contributed to application maintenance, production troubleshooting, and improvements to system performance and reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained web applications and marketing technology solutions supporting digital marketing and business operations.

Key Contributions:
• Web Development: Developed and maintained application functionality supporting marketing and business workflows.
• Application Maintenance: Troubleshot production issues, improved existing functionality, and supported ongoing system modernization.
• Performance & Reliability: Contributed to application performance improvements through debugging, maintenance, and technical enhancements.

positions.title: Programmer / Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained web applications supporting shipping, logistics, and internal business operations.

Key Contributions:
• Application Development: Built web application functionality supporting shipping-related workflows and business processes.
• Database Integration: Developed database integrations supporting operational data management and application functionality.
• System Maintenance: Maintained and improved existing applications, resolving technical issues and enhancing day-to-day usability and reliability.
